title: Configuration parameter versus lock configuration
summary: The model-specific community configuration and HA's generic actions describe different interfaces. A configuration-parameter write must not be equated with Door Lock CC auto_relock_time.

observations.claim: The YRD156 configuration imports parameter 3's auto-relock duration definition: seconds, 0–180, default 30. Parameter 2 separately enables auto-relock.
conditions: Community configuration only; parameter availability and enable/disable semantics need firmware-specific confirmation.
The chosen tuple is not interchangeable with every Yale model or protocol variant.

observations.claim: set_config_parameter declares parameter, value, endpoint and optional value_size fields. This is a generic entry point for configuration parameters, not a YRD156-specific successful write.
conditions: Requires the relevant runtime node metadata, permissions and supported parameter.
The pinned catalog Z-Wave JS config is a comparison baseline, not a claim that HA deploys exactly that revision.

observations.claim: async_set_lock_configuration passes auto_relock_time to DoorLockCCConfigurationSetOptions. This protocol-level option is not proof of equivalence to Yale's configuration parameter 3.
conditions: Device command-class version and actual supported options are unknown for this case.
No operational instructions, write payloads or safe setting recommendation are provided.

limitations: Human-authored candidate observations; no independent EdgeLoom review or physical-device test.
Sources are pinned snapshots, not a claim about the currently installed integration, coordinator or firmware.
Relationship labels are curator interpretations, not computed semantic equivalence. Conflicting observations must remain visible.
HA and Z-Wave JS share a backend lineage; they are not two independent attestations of the device's behavior.
The lineage edge records shared stack ancestry, not an exact runtime dependency/version lock.
